chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
He who gives generously achieves position. (Or: He who achieves position begins to make wrong use of it.)

key_terms.اسْتَطَالَ: He becomes long / achieves position / makes use

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the phrase 'He who gives generously achieves position' in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) presents the aphorism 'man nala istatāl' (he who receives becomes arrogant), a principle deeply rooted in the Shia understanding of human psychology and social dynamics. Scholars note that this brevity captures the dual risk of generosity: it can either elevate the giver's honor through magnanimity or corrupt the recipient through entitlement, reflecting the transient nature of worldly favor. This saying serves as a cautionary ethical guideline for leaders and individuals alike, emphasizing the need for humility in both giving and receiving.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 216. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
He who gives generously achieves position. (Or according to another interpretation): He who achieves position begins to make wrong use of it.
